title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Term, Billing Frequency, Payment Terms and Arrears Figures
content:
## Accounts receivable terms sheet

The term length, invoicing frequency, instalment count, payment terms, late fee rate, suspension period, reinstatement fee, expired-agreement reinstatement window and for-cause cancellation period of each tier of the Preventive Maintenance Agreements are as published below.

| Tier | Length of one agreement term (calendar months) | How the annual price is invoiced | Installments per agreement year | Days from invoice date to due date (calendar days) | Late fee on an installment past due, per month (percent per month) | Calendar days past due after which coverage is suspended | Fee billed on reinstatement of a suspended or expired agreement (USD) | Calendar days after term end within which an expired agreement can be reinstated without a new pre-agreement inspection | Calendar days after suspension after which a still-unpaid agreement is cancelled for cause |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter & Belt Service Plan | 12 | annual | 1 | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 75 | 30 | 60 |
| Inspection Agreement | 12 | annual | 1 | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 75 | 30 | 60 |
| Preventive Maintenance Agreement | 12 | quarterly | 4 | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 150 | 45 | 60 |
| Labor Coverage Agreement | 12 | quarterly | 4 | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 250 | 45 | 60 |
| Full Coverage Agreement | 12 | monthly | 12 | 30 | 1.5 | 30 | 400 | 60 | 45 |
| Comprehensive Performance Agreement | 36 | monthly | 12 | 45 | 1.0 | 30 | 750 | 90 | 45 |

### Sheet notes

- Every tier runs a 12-month term except the Comprehensive Performance Agreement, whose term is 36 months.
- The two entry tiers are invoiced annually in 1 installment; the Preventive Maintenance Agreement and the Labor Coverage Agreement quarterly in 4; the Full Coverage Agreement and the Comprehensive Performance Agreement monthly in 12.
- Payment terms are 30 calendar days at every tier except the Comprehensive Performance Agreement, where they are 45.
- The late fee is 1.5 percent per month at every tier except the Comprehensive Performance Agreement, where it is 1.0 percent per month.
- Coverage is suspended 45 days past due at the four lower tiers and 30 days past due at the two upper tiers; the reinstatement fee runs from 75 USD to 750 USD; the expired-agreement reinstatement window runs from 30 to 90 calendar days; the for-cause period is 60 days at the four lower tiers and 45 days at the two upper tiers.
